record_title: Exact subalgebra commutativity degree of the five-dimensional Heisenberg algebra
limitations: The exact formula is proved for the five-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra and the general symplectic graph criterion is supplied, but no closed formula for arbitrary Heisenberg rank is claimed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the motivating invariant is very recent, and a specialized group-theoretic formula not surfaced by the literature search could imply an odd-prime specialization through Lazard correspondence. The exhaustive computation checks q=2 and q=3 only; the general prime-power statement rests on the proof. No independent validation is asserted.

artifact_inventory.purpose: Exhaustive verification over the prime fields q=2 and q=3
